title.narrative: Strengthening capacity for the implementation of the Nepal School Education Sector Plan

description.narrative: The purpose of this Action is to strengthen institutional capacity across federal, provincial and local government tiers for them to successfully implement the SESP, resulting in equitable, inclusive, and quality education, from pre-primary to grade 12, in a safe and supportive environment for all girls and boys, especially from the most disadvantaged communities.
